title: Structural Measurement Charge — Repair Estimates & Appointments Fee Schedule Clause
content:
**Clause.** The measurement charge on a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking whose estimate type produces a structural measurement report is rounded to the cent once on the final figure. The standard measurement charge is a fresh measurement at the estimate type's structural measurement fee.

| Element | What it is |
|---|---|
| Measurement | A fresh electronic three-dimensional structural measurement of the vehicle |
| Amount | The estimate type's structural measurement fee, as scheduled for that type |
| Rounding | To the cent, once, on the final figure |

**Worked figure** (hypothetical fee for illustration, not a scheduled value): an estimate type with a structural measurement fee of 120.00 USD gives a measurement charge of 120.00 USD.

**Basis Q&A**

*Which estimate types produce a structural measurement report?* Those whose scope includes the structural measurement report; on any other type no measurement charge arises.

*When is the charge rounded?* Once, on the final figure.
